items.title: Quentin Grimes Scores 47 as Lakers Beat Hornets in Overtime
items.titleZh: 葛萊姆斯狂砍 47 分 湖人延長賽逆轉黃蜂
items.teaser: 葛萊姆斯投進 10 記三分，最後 1.7 秒追平逼進延長賽！湖人下半場曾落後 18 分，最後 118 比 114 逆轉，拿下九連勝。
paras: Quentin Grimes scored a career-high 47 points as the Los Angeles Lakers came back to beat the Charlotte Hornets 118-114 in overtime on Tuesday night. The Lakers had trailed by 18 points in the second half. It was their ninth straight win, and they are now 13-2.
週二晚上，葛萊姆斯（Quentin Grimes）攻下生涯新高 47 分，帶領洛杉磯湖人在延長賽以 118 比 114 逆轉夏洛特黃蜂。湖人下半場一度落後 18 分。這是他們的九連勝，戰績來到 13 勝 2 敗。

Grimes made 10 3-pointers and scored 21 points in the fourth quarter. Charlotte led 110-106 with 20 seconds left, but Luka Doncic found Grimes, who hit his 10th 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds remaining to force overtime. Grimes joined Kobe Bryant as the only Lakers players to make 10 3-pointers in a game.
葛萊姆斯投進 10 記三分球，光第四節就拿下 21 分。黃蜂在剩 20 秒時以 110 比 106 領先，但東契奇（Luka Doncic）傳球給葛萊姆斯，他在剩 1.7 秒時投進自己的第 10 記三分，把比賽逼進延長賽。葛萊姆斯和柯比（Kobe Bryant）成為湖人隊史僅有的兩位單場投進 10 記三分的球員。

Doncic added 36 points and seven assists. In overtime, Grimes forced a turnover with 17.4 seconds left and made two free throws to seal the win. Brandon Miller and Naz Reid each scored 28 points for Charlotte, which has lost nine of its last 10 games.
東契奇貢獻 36 分、7 助攻。延長賽剩 17.4 秒時，葛萊姆斯逼出對手失誤，再罰進兩球鎖定勝利。黃蜂的米勒（Brandon Miller）和瑞德（Naz Reid）各拿 28 分；黃蜂最近 10 場比賽輸了 9 場。
words: 不可數｜adv. overtime 加班地｜work overtime 加班｜go into overtime 進入延長賽
n. career high 生涯新高｜a career-high 47 points 生涯新高的 47 分
forces · forced · forcing｜n. force 力量；武力｜force overtime 逼進延長賽
複數 turnovers｜force a turnover 逼出失誤｜staff turnover 員工流動率
seals · sealed · sealing｜n. seal 印章；海豹｜seal the win 鎖定勝利

analysis.zh: 黃蜂在剩 20 秒時以 110 比 106 領先，但東契奇傳球給葛萊姆斯，他在剩 1.7 秒時投進第 10 記三分，把比賽逼進延長賽。
parts: 非限定關係子句（補充說明 Grimes）
修飾（with + 名詞 + V-ing 表示當時的狀況）
不定詞表結果（逼進延長賽）
analysis.note: with 20 seconds left 和 with 1.7 seconds remaining 都是「with + 名詞 + 分詞」，用來說明「在剩下多少時間的情況下」，left 是過去分詞、remaining 是現在分詞，意思一樣。逗號後的 who… 是非限定關係子句，補充說明葛萊姆斯做了什麼。

analysis.zh: 延長賽剩 17.4 秒時，葛萊姆斯逼出對手失誤，再罰進兩球鎖定勝利。
parts: 動詞 2（and 連接同一個主詞的第二個動作）
analysis.note: 同一個主詞做了兩件事時，可以用 and 連接兩個動詞（forced … and made …），不必重複主詞。句尾 to seal the win 是不定詞，說明這兩球的作用是「鎖定勝利」。

quiz.q: How many points did Quentin Grimes score?
quiz.ex: 第一段：scored a career-high 47 points。36 分是東契奇，28 分是米勒和瑞德，118 是湖人總得分。

quiz.q: How did the game go into overtime?
opts: Grimes hit a 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds left.
Charlotte missed a shot at the buzzer.
quiz.ex: 第二段：Grimes hit his 10th 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds remaining to force overtime，是葛萊姆斯的三分球把比賽逼進延長賽。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The Lakers led by 18 points in the second half.
The Lakers have lost two games this season.
Charlotte has won nine of its last 10 games.
quiz.ex: 第一段：they are now 13-2，湖人只輸兩場。湖人下半場是「落後」18 分；黃蜂是最近 10 場輸 9 場；47 分是葛萊姆斯。

source.title: ESPN（AP）：Quentin Grimes scores 47, forces OT with 10th 3-pointer as Lakers rally past Hornets 118-114（2026/11/18）

items.title: Samsung and TSMC Shares Fall After New U.S. Chip Curbs on China
items.titleZh: 美國加強限制中國取得 AI 晶片 三星、台積電股價下跌
items.teaser: 美國新規：先進 AI 晶片賣到新加坡、馬來西亞等五國要申請許可，晶圓代工廠替中國客戶代工也要多一層審查，三星、台積電股價應聲下跌近 5%。
paras: Shares of Samsung Electronics and TSMC fell nearly 5% in Asian trading on November 17. The drop came after the United States announced new rules to further limit China's access to advanced AI chips. Other chip-related stocks in the region also fell.
11 月 17 日，三星電子和台積電的股價在亞洲交易時段下跌將近 5%。下跌的原因是美國宣布新規定，要進一步限制中國取得先進 AI 晶片。區域內其他和晶片相關的股票也跟著下跌。

Under the new rules, shipments of advanced AI chips to data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil will require U.S. export licenses. Washington sees these countries as places where chips are at higher risk of being sent to China. The rules also add checks on overseas data centers that rent large amounts of computing power to Chinese companies.
根據新規定，先進 AI 晶片要運到新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國、印尼和巴西的資料中心，都必須取得美國的出口許可。美國政府認為，晶片在這些國家被轉送到中國的風險較高。新規定也加強審查那些把大量運算能力出租給中國公司的海外資料中心。

Foundries that make advanced chips for Chinese fabless companies will also face tighter requirements. An analyst at CLSA said Samsung's foundry business might need extra customer checks and licenses. Such measures could raise compliance costs and cause delays for companies with Chinese customers.
替中國「無晶圓廠」晶片設計公司生產先進晶片的晶圓代工廠，也將面臨更嚴格的要求。里昂證券（CLSA）一位分析師表示，三星的晶圓代工業務可能需要額外的客戶審查和許可。這些措施可能提高法規遵循的成本，也會讓有中國客戶的公司遇到延誤。
words: 複數 foundries｜foundry business 晶圓代工業務
無晶圓廠的（只設計晶片、委外生產）
fab（晶圓廠）+ -less（沒有）｜a fabless chip company 無晶圓廠晶片公司
複數 licenses｜v. license 核發許可（licenses · licensed · licensing）｜export license 出口許可
不可數｜v. comply (with) 遵守｜adj. compliant 合規的｜compliance costs 合規成本
複數 shipments｜v. ship 運送（ships · shipped · shipping）

analysis.zh: 根據新規定，先進 AI 晶片要運到新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國、印尼和巴西的資料中心，都必須取得美國的出口許可。
parts: shipments of advanced AI chips to data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil
主詞（核心是 shipments，後面的 of…、to…、in… 都是修飾）
analysis.note: 這句的主詞很長，但真正的主詞只有 shipments（出貨），後面接了三個介系詞片語：of（什麼貨）、to（運到哪）、in（在哪些國家）。讀長句時先找到核心名詞和動詞 will require，句子就清楚了。

analysis.zh: 替中國無晶圓廠公司生產先進晶片的晶圓代工廠，也將面臨更嚴格的要求。
parts: that make advanced chips for Chinese fabless companies
限定關係子句（說明是哪些代工廠）
analysis.note: that make… 是限定關係子句，用來限定「哪些」代工廠，不能拿掉，所以前面沒有逗號。關係子句的動詞 make 要和先行詞 Foundries（複數）一致。tighter 是 tight 的比較級，tight requirements 指「嚴格的規定」。

quiz.q: Why did Samsung and TSMC shares fall?
opts: The U.S. announced new limits on China's access to AI chips.
quiz.ex: 第一段：The drop came after the United States announced new rules to further limit China's access to advanced AI chips。

quiz.q: Which country is NOT named in the new license rule?
quiz.ex: 第二段列出的五國是 Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil，沒有日本。

quiz.q: What might the new rules mean for companies with Chinese customers?
quiz.ex: 第三段：Such measures could raise compliance costs and cause delays for companies with Chinese customers。

source.title: TipRanks：Samsung, TSMC Stocks Slide as U.S. Tightens AI Chip Curbs on China（2026/11/17）

items.title: President Lai Urges Opposition to Drop NT$20,000 Cash Handout Bill
items.titleZh: 賴總統呼籲在野黨別推全民發 2 萬元現金法案
items.teaser: 行政院原本規劃每人發 1 萬元，國民黨提案加碼到 2 萬元，立法院最快週五表決。國民黨說今年稅收超乎預期、有空間；賴清德則說會破壞財政平衡。
paras: President Lai Ching-te on Wednesday urged opposition parties not to pass a bill that would give every member of the public a cash handout of NT$20,000. The opposition-controlled Legislature could reportedly vote on the bill as early as Friday.
賴清德總統週三呼籲在野黨，不要通過一項全民每人發放 2 萬元現金的法案。據報導，在野黨占多數的立法院最快週五就可能表決這項法案。

In August, the Cabinet proposed giving each person NT$10,000 in its 2027 budget, setting aside NT$235.7 billion for the plan. The Kuomintang (KMT) wants to double the amount through a special budget, arguing that higher-than-expected tax revenue this year, driven largely by the AI boom, leaves enough room. In mid-October, the Taiwan People's Party (TPP) voted to send the bill straight to a second reading without committee review.
行政院在 8 月提出的 2027 年度預算中，規劃全民每人發放 1 萬元，為此編列 2,357 億元。國民黨則希望透過特別預算把金額加倍，理由是今年稅收高於預期、主要受到 AI 熱潮帶動，財政有足夠空間。民眾黨在 10 月中旬投票，讓這項法案不經委員會審查、直接進入二讀。

According to a Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) spokesperson, Lai said the bill would hurt fiscal balance, take money away from other priorities and increase government debt for future generations. He also said it would encroach on the Cabinet's authority over the budget.
根據民進黨發言人轉述，賴清德表示，這項法案會破壞財政平衡、排擠其他優先項目的經費，並增加政府債務、留給後代承擔。他也說，這項法案侵犯了行政院在預算上的權限。
words: 複數 handouts｜v. hand out 分發｜a cash handout 現金發放
常用複數 revenues｜tax revenue 稅收｜sales revenue 營業收入
adv. fiscally｜fiscal balance 財政平衡｜fiscal year 會計年度
複數 priorities｜v. prioritize 優先處理｜top priority 第一優先
encroaches · encroached · encroaching｜n. encroachment 侵犯｜encroach on/upon 侵犯…

analysis.zh: 國民黨希望透過特別預算把金額加倍，理由是今年稅收高於預期、主要受到 AI 熱潮帶動，財政有足夠空間。
parts: arguing that higher-than-expected tax revenue this year, driven largely by the AI boom, leaves enough room.
分詞構句（arguing 說明理由，後接 that 子句）
analysis.note: arguing… 是分詞構句，等於 and it argues that…，用來補充主詞的理由。that 子句裡，driven largely by the AI boom 是過去分詞片語，插在中間補充說明稅收「受到什麼帶動」；子句真正的主詞是 tax revenue，動詞是 leaves。higher-than-expected 用連字號組成形容詞，意思是「高於預期的」。

analysis.zh: 賴清德總統週三呼籲在野黨，不要通過一項全民每人發放 2 萬元現金的法案。
parts: 受詞補語（urge + 人 + not to V）
that would give every member of the public a cash handout of NT$20,000.
關係子句（修飾 a bill；give + 人 + 物）
analysis.note: urge someone (not) to do something 是「呼籲某人（不要）做某事」，否定時 not 放在 to 前面。that would give… 是關係子句，說明是什麼法案；would 表示法案「若通過將會」怎樣。give + 人 + 物 是雙受詞句型：give every member of the public（給誰）a cash handout（給什麼）。

quiz.q: How much cash per person did the Cabinet first propose?
quiz.ex: 第二段：the Cabinet proposed giving each person NT$10,000。2 萬元是國民黨版本，2,357 億元是整個計畫編列的金額。

quiz.q: What reason does the KMT give for doubling the amount?
opts: Tax revenue was higher than expected.
quiz.ex: 第二段：arguing that higher-than-expected tax revenue this year … leaves enough room，國民黨認為稅收高於預期，財政有空間。

quiz.q: Which of these did Lai NOT say about the bill?
opts: It would encroach on the Cabinet's authority.
It would raise taxes next year.
quiz.ex: 第三段提到財政平衡、排擠其他優先項目、增加債務、侵犯行政院權限，沒有說會在明年加稅。

source.title: Focus Taiwan（CNA）：Taiwan's president urges opposition to drop NT$20,000 cash handout proposal（2026/11/18）

items.title: Tiny Space Dust Points to Ancient Ice Beyond Neptune
items.titleZh: 小小太空塵埃 揭露海王星外的遠古冰
items.teaser: NASA 用高空飛機在平流層收集了 12 顆微小塵埃，一路追查出它們來自古柏帶，還找到遠古的水留下的痕跡。
paras: NASA scientists have found strong evidence of an ancient store of ice in the Kuiper Belt, a distant region of the solar system beyond Neptune. Surprisingly, the clues came from tiny grains of space dust collected high in Earth's own atmosphere.
NASA 科學家找到有力證據，顯示古柏帶——太陽系裡位於海王星外的遙遠區域——存在一座遠古的冰庫。令人意外的是，線索來自在地球自己大氣層高處收集到的微小太空塵埃顆粒。

The team studied 12 dust particles collected from the stratosphere by NASA's ER-2 high-altitude research aircraft. Working with colleagues at UCLA, they used electron microscopes and an ion microprobe to examine the particles' minerals and oxygen isotopes. Large numbers of tracks left by energetic particles from the Sun helped show that the dust came from the Kuiper Belt.
研究團隊分析了 NASA 的 ER-2 高空研究機從平流層收集到的 12 顆塵埃粒子。他們和加州大學洛杉磯分校（UCLA）的同事合作，用電子顯微鏡和離子微探針檢查這些粒子的礦物與氧同位素。粒子上有大量太陽高能粒子留下的痕跡，幫助證明這些塵埃來自古柏帶。

The researchers found minerals that formed when water interacted with dust early in the solar system's history. This ancient water was rich in heavier oxygen isotopes. Because similar signs are rare in meteorites, giant planets may have limited the mixing between the outer and inner solar system.
研究人員找到一些礦物，是在太陽系歷史早期、水和塵埃發生作用時形成的。這些遠古的水含有較多較重的氧同位素。由於隕石裡很少看到類似的特徵，巨大的行星可能限制了太陽系外圍和內側之間物質的混合。
words: 比較級 more ancient｜ancient history 古代史
複數 grains｜a grain of sand 一粒沙｜grains of dust 塵埃顆粒
adj. stratospheric 平流層的；極高的｜in the stratosphere 在平流層
複數 isotopes｜adj. isotopic｜oxygen isotopes 氧同位素
複數 meteorites｜n. meteor 流星｜n. meteoroid 流星體

analysis.zh: 研究人員找到一些礦物，是在太陽系歷史早期、水和塵埃發生作用時形成的。
parts: when 引導的時間副詞子句
early in the solar system's history.
analysis.note: 這句有兩層子句：that formed 說明是「什麼樣的礦物」，when water interacted with dust 再說明礦物「什麼時候」形成。interact with 是「和…相互作用」，科學文章很常用。

analysis.zh: 由於隕石裡很少看到類似的特徵，巨大的行星可能限制了太陽系外圍和內側之間物質的混合。
parts: Because similar signs are rare in meteorites,
between the outer and inner solar system.
analysis.note: may have + p.p. 表示對「過去」的推測：「可能曾經…」。科學家不能百分之百確定時，常用 may have / might have 讓語氣保留。Because 子句放句首時，後面要加逗號。

quiz.q: Where were the dust particles collected?
opts: In the Kuiper Belt by a spacecraft
quiz.ex: 第一、二段：dust collected high in Earth's own atmosphere，由 ER-2 高空研究機從平流層收集。

quiz.q: How many dust particles did the team study?
quiz.ex: 第二段：The team studied 12 dust particles。

quiz.q: What does the passage suggest about giant planets?
opts: They may have limited mixing between the outer and inner solar system.
They are made of ancient ice.
quiz.ex: 第三段：giant planets may have limited the mixing between the outer and inner solar system。

source.title: NASA Science：NASA Scientists Find Clues to Ancient Ice Beyond Neptune（2026/11/18）

items.title: Jazz Snap Lakers' Nine-Game Winning Streak
items.titleZh: 爵士 109 比 97 擊敗湖人 終結湖人九連勝
items.teaser: 前一晚還在延長賽逆轉的湖人，碰上開季 1 勝 13 敗的爵士竟然熄火！東契奇三分 12 投 2 中、9 次失誤，湖人九連勝就此中斷。
paras: The Utah Jazz snapped the Los Angeles Lakers' nine-game winning streak with a 109-97 victory on Wednesday night. Keyonte George led Utah with 30 points, and Ace Bailey added 19 points, including 10 in the fourth quarter.
猶他爵士週三晚上以 109 比 97 擊敗洛杉磯湖人，終結湖人的九連勝。喬治（Keyonte George）攻下全隊最高 30 分，貝利（Ace Bailey）也貢獻 19 分，其中 10 分在第四節。

The game was close until Utah scored 15 straight points over three and a half minutes in the fourth quarter to lead 98-83. The Lakers fought back briefly, but the Jazz then scored 10 points in a row to seal the win. Los Angeles shot just 38.2%, its lowest of the season.
比賽一直很接近，直到第四節爵士在三分半鐘內連拿 15 分，以 98 比 83 領先。湖人一度短暫追分，但爵士接著又連得 10 分，鎖定勝利。湖人全場命中率只有 38.2%，是本季最低。

Luka Doncic scored 29 points but had nine turnovers and made only 2 of 12 3-point attempts, ending his streak of 11 straight 30-point games. One night after scoring a career-high 47, Quentin Grimes had 20 points. The Jazz started the season 1-13, but they have now beaten both Los Angeles teams in two days.
東契奇（Luka Doncic）拿下 29 分，但有 9 次失誤，三分球 12 投只進 2 球，連續 11 場得分 30 分以上的紀錄也就此中斷。前一晚才拿下生涯新高 47 分的葛萊姆斯（Quentin Grimes）這場拿 20 分。爵士開季戰績是 1 勝 13 敗，但兩天內已經接連擊敗洛杉磯的兩支球隊。
words: snaps · snapped · snapping｜snap a winning streak 終結連勝｜n. snap 啪的一聲
複數 streaks｜a winning streak 連勝｜a losing streak 連敗
複數 victories｜adj. victorious 勝利的｜win a victory 獲勝
adv. straight 直接地｜15 straight points 連續 15 分｜比較級 straighter · straightest
複數 attempts｜v. attempt 嘗試（attempts · attempted · attempting）｜3-point attempts 三分球出手

analysis.zh: 比賽一直很接近，直到第四節爵士在三分半鐘內連拿 15 分，以 98 比 83 領先。
parts: until 引導的時間副詞子句
over three and a half minutes
不定詞表結果（因此領先）
analysis.note: be close 在球賽裡是「比分接近」。until 引導副詞子句，表示「直到…為止」，前面的狀態（比賽接近）在子句發生時結束。over + 一段時間 表示「在這段時間裡」。句尾 to lead 98-83 是不定詞表結果。

items.title: Prices of Next-Generation AI Memory Could Nearly Triple Next Year
items.titleZh: AI 記憶體 HBM4 明年價格恐漲到 2.7 倍
items.teaser: AI 晶片少不了的高頻寬記憶體 HBM，新一代 HBM4 明年每 Gb 可能從約 2.05 美元漲到最高 5.5 美元！三星、SK 海力士、美光把更多晶圓拿去做 HBM，一般 DRAM 也跟著漲。
paras: Prices for HBM4, the newest generation of high-bandwidth memory used in AI chips, could rise as much as 2.7 times next year, according to the market research firm TrendForce. Speaking at an event in Seoul on November 18, the firm said HBM4 could cost between $3 and $5.5 per gigabit, compared with about $2.05 this year.
市調機構集邦科技（TrendForce）表示，AI 晶片使用的最新一代高頻寬記憶體 HBM4，明年價格最多可能漲到 2.7 倍。集邦 11 月 18 日在首爾的活動上說，HBM4 每 Gb 的價格可能落在 3 到 5.5 美元，今年大約是 2.05 美元。

HBM is made mainly by the "memory big three": Samsung Electronics, SK hynix and Micron. Because HBM needs about three to four times as many wafers as ordinary DRAM for the same capacity, these companies are shifting more of their production to it. TrendForce expects HBM to take close to 30% of their DRAM wafers next year, up from 23% this year.
HBM 主要由「記憶體三巨頭」生產：三星電子、SK 海力士和美光。因為同樣的容量，HBM 需要的晶圓大約是一般 DRAM 的三到四倍，這些公司正把更多產能轉去做 HBM。集邦預估，明年 HBM 會占三巨頭 DRAM 晶圓投片量將近 30%，今年是 23%。

Prices of conventional DRAM are also climbing, and TrendForce expects them to rise 10 to 15% in the fourth quarter of 2026. To meet demand, Samsung and SK hynix are planning large new production lines in South Korea. Even so, the firm said the supply picture may not change until around 2028.
一般 DRAM 的價格也在上漲，集邦預估 2026 年第四季會比上一季漲 10% 到 15%。為了滿足需求，三星和 SK 海力士都在南韓規劃大型新產線。即便如此，集邦認為 DRAM 的供應局面可能要到 2028 年左右才會改變。
words: 複數 generations｜the next generation 下一代｜v. generate 產生
複數 wafers｜wafer input 晶圓投片量｜a 12-inch wafer 12 吋晶圓
複數 capacities｜production capacity 產能｜at full capacity 滿載
adv. conventionally 傳統上｜n. convention 慣例；大會
複數 demands｜meet demand 滿足需求｜v. demand 要求（demands · demanded · demanding）

parts: Because HBM needs about three to four times as many wafers as ordinary DRAM for the same capacity,
Because 引導的原因副詞子句
修飾（轉移到哪裡；it 指 HBM）
analysis.note: 倍數的說法：X times as many + 名詞 + as…（是…的 X 倍）。shift A to B 是「把 A 轉移到 B」。原因子句放句首時，後面要加逗號再接主要子句。

同位語（說明 HBM4 是什麼）

quiz.ex: 第二段：TrendForce expects HBM to take close to 30% of their DRAM wafers next year, up from 23% this year。23% 是今年。

items.title: MAC Says Taiwan Unlikely to Be Focus of Trump-Xi-Putin Talks
items.titleZh: 陸委會：川習普會談 台灣應不是焦點
items.teaser: 美中俄三位領袖在深圳 APEC 場邊會面，陸委會說「就我們所知，台灣不是焦點」；會後新華社則轉述了習近平和川普談到台灣的內容。
paras: Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) said on Thursday that Taiwan was unlikely to be a main topic when U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin met on the sidelines of APEC in Shenzhen. MAC deputy head Liang Wen-chieh said the talks were expected to focus mainly on a ceasefire in Ukraine and Iran's nuclear program.
陸委會週四表示，美國總統川普、中國領導人習近平和俄羅斯總統普丁在深圳 APEC 場邊會面時，台灣應該不會是主要議題。陸委會副主委梁文傑說，會談預計主要聚焦在烏克蘭停火和伊朗核計畫。

"Even if Taiwan is mentioned, it will be a relatively peripheral issue," Liang said at a regular news briefing. He did not name a specific source of information, but he pointed to the limited time for talks and said the three leaders "want different things."
梁文傑在例行記者會上說：「就算提到台灣，也會是比較邊緣的議題。」他沒有說明具體的資訊管道，但指出會談時間有限，並說三方「想要的東西不一樣」。

After a separate meeting between Xi and Trump, China's state news agency Xinhua reported that Xi told Trump Washington should "stick to doing the right thing" on Taiwan, and that Trump said the U.S. "does not support Taiwan independence." The White House had not released its own account of that meeting, and Taiwan's government had not responded when the report was published.
在習近平和川普另外舉行的雙邊會談後，中國官方的新華社報導，習近平對川普說美方在台灣問題上應「堅持做正確的事」，並稱川普表示美國「不支持台灣獨立」。白宮當時還沒有發布自己對這場會談的說明，報導發出時台灣政府也尚未回應。
words: focuses · focused · focusing｜focus on… 專注於…｜n. focus 焦點（複數 focuses / foci）
複數 ceasefires｜agree to a ceasefire 同意停火｜v. cease 停止
adv. peripherally｜n. periphery 邊緣；外圍
複數 briefings｜a news briefing 記者會｜v. brief 向…簡報（briefs · briefed · briefing）
adv. separately 分別地｜v. separate /ˈsepəreɪt/ 分開（separates · separated · separating）

analysis.zh: 陸委會副主委梁文傑說，會談預計主要聚焦在烏克蘭停火和伊朗核計畫。
parts: the talks were expected to focus mainly on a ceasefire in Ukraine and Iran's nuclear program.
受詞（省略 that 的名詞子句）
analysis.note: said 後面接名詞子句當受詞，連接詞 that 常省略。子句裡 be expected to + V 是「預計會…」，是新聞很常見的被動說法；focus on A and B 表示「聚焦在 A 和 B」。

analysis.zh: 梁文傑在例行記者會上說：「就算提到台灣，也會是比較邊緣的議題。」
parts: Even if 引導的讓步子句（就算…）
it will be a relatively peripheral issue,"
analysis.note: 新聞常把引號放在句首，後面再接「誰 + said」。Even if 表示「即使（假設情況發生）」，和 even though（雖然，事實已發生）不同。Taiwan is mentioned 是被動語態。

opts: A ceasefire in Ukraine and Iran's nuclear program
quiz.ex: 第一段：the talks were expected to focus mainly on a ceasefire in Ukraine and Iran's nuclear program。

quiz.q: What did Liang say about the three leaders?
opts: They would discuss Taiwan for a long time.
quiz.ex: 第二段：said the three leaders "want different things"。他也提到會談時間有限。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The White House released a full account of the Xi-Trump meeting.
Xinhua reported what Xi and Trump said about Taiwan.
Liang named his source of information.
quiz.ex: 第三段：Xinhua reported that Xi told Trump…。白宮當時還沒發布說明，台灣政府還沒回應，梁文傑也沒有說出資訊來源。

items.title: Giant Dinosaur Lay Under a Chinese Street for Decades
items.titleZh: 巨型恐龍在重慶街道下沉睡多年
items.teaser: 1998 年工人在重慶潼南挖路時挖到大骨頭，多年後科學家確認是新物種「志明潼南龍」，估計身長約 25 到 26 公尺！
paras: In 1998, workers digging on Dafo Street in Tongnan District, Chongqing, China, found some large bones. The remains were kept in a local collection for many years. Now scientists say they belong to a new species of giant dinosaur called Tongnanlong zhimingi.
1998 年，工人在中國重慶潼南區的大佛街施工挖掘時，挖到一些巨大的骨頭。這些遺骸多年來一直放在當地的收藏中。現在科學家表示，它們屬於一種新的巨型恐龍物種，名叫「志明潼南龍」（Tongnanlong zhimingi）。

The name comes from Tongnan District and "long," the Chinese word for dragon. The species name honors the famous paleontologist Dong Zhiming. The study was led by Xuefang Wei of the Chengdu Center of the China Geological Survey and was published in the journal Scientific Reports.
屬名來自潼南區加上中文的「龍」；種名則是向著名古生物學家董枝明致敬。這項研究由中國地質調查局成都中心的魏雪芳（Xuefang Wei）主導，發表在期刊《科學報告》（Scientific Reports）。

The fossil includes bones from the back and tail, a shoulder blade, leg bones, foot bones and claws, but no skull or neck. Based on these bones, scientists estimate the dinosaur was about 25 to 26 meters long. It lived around 147 million years ago, in the Late Jurassic period.
這副化石包括背部和尾巴的骨頭、一塊肩胛骨、腿骨、腳骨和爪子，但沒有頭骨和脖子。根據這些骨頭，科學家估計這隻恐龍身長大約 25 到 26 公尺。牠生活在大約 1 億 4,700 萬年前的侏羅紀晚期。
words: 只用複數｜human remains 人類遺骸｜v. remain 保持；剩下（remains · remained · remaining）
單複數同形 species｜a new species 新物種｜endangered species 瀕危物種
honors · honored · honoring｜n. honor 榮譽｜in honor of… 為了紀念…
複數 fossils｜fossil fuel 化石燃料｜v. fossilize 使變成化石

analysis.zh: 1998 年，工人在中國重慶潼南區的大佛街施工挖掘時，挖到一些巨大的骨頭。
parts: digging on Dafo Street in Tongnan District, Chongqing, China,
現在分詞片語（修飾 workers：正在挖掘的工人）
analysis.note: workers digging on… 是「名詞 + 現在分詞片語」，等於 workers who were digging on…，省略了關係代名詞和 be 動詞。地名由小到大排列：街道 → 區 → 城市 → 國家，用逗號隔開。

analysis.zh: 根據這些骨頭，科學家估計這隻恐龍身長大約 25 到 26 公尺。

受詞（省略 that 的名詞子句）
analysis.note: Based on… 放在句首表示「根據…」，是很常見的過去分詞片語。estimate 後面接名詞子句（省略 that）。描述長度用「數字 + 單位 + long」，例如 25 meters long。

quiz.ex: 第一段：In 1998, workers digging on Dafo Street … found some large bones。1 億 4,700 萬年前是恐龍生活的年代。

quiz.ex: 第二段：The species name honors the famous paleontologist Dong Zhiming。魏雪芳是主導研究的學者。

quiz.ex: 第三段：… but no skull or neck，沒有找到頭骨和脖子。

items.title: Grizzlies Rout Short-Handed Warriors for Fifth Straight Win
items.titleZh: 灰熊 126 比 98 大勝缺兵的勇士 拿下五連勝
items.teaser: 柯瑞、格林都沒上場的勇士，到曼菲斯被灰熊從頭打到尾，最多落後 34 分！三分球 29 投只進 5 球，勇士客場之旅 5 戰全敗。
paras: The Memphis Grizzlies beat the Golden State Warriors 126-98 on Thursday night for their fifth straight win. Jaylen Wells led Memphis with 22 points, and Cedric Coward added 19. Memphis never trailed in the game.
曼菲斯灰熊週四晚上以 126 比 98 擊敗金州勇士，拿下五連勝。威爾斯（Jaylen Wells）攻下全隊最高 22 分，考沃德（Cedric Coward）也拿 19 分。灰熊整場比賽從來沒有落後過。

The Warriors were playing without Stephen Curry, who has a torn oblique muscle, and Draymond Green, who has an elbow injury. Charles Bassey had 16 points and 13 rebounds for Golden State, but the team made only 5 of 29 3-point shots. Memphis led by as many as 34 points in the fourth quarter.
勇士這場少了腹斜肌撕裂的柯瑞（Stephen Curry）和手肘受傷的格林（Draymond Green）。巴西（Charles Bassey）幫勇士拿下 16 分、13 個籃板，但全隊三分球 29 投只進 5 球。灰熊在第四節一度領先多達 34 分。
The loss was Golden State's fifth in a row, and the team finished its road trip 0-5. The Grizzlies, who were also missing two key players, improved to 12-4. They play at Minnesota on Saturday.
這是勇士的五連敗，這趟客場之旅以 0 勝 5 敗結束。同樣少了兩名主力的灰熊，戰績提升到 12 勝 4 敗，週六將到明尼蘇達作客。

items.title: TSMC Buys a US$500 Million Stake in AI Company Anthropic
items.titleZh: 台積電斥資 5 億美元 入股 AI 公司 Anthropic
items.teaser: 全球最大晶圓代工廠也買 AI 股！台積電以 IPO 價每股 83 美元，買進 Anthropic 約 602 萬股，花了 5 億美元，卻只占約 0.03%——因為這家公司估值高達 1.5 兆美元。
paras: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC), the world's largest contract chipmaker, said on Thursday that it had bought shares in the American AI company Anthropic for about US$500 million. A TSMC subsidiary, TSMC Partners, acquired 6,024,096 shares at US$83 each.
全球最大的晶圓代工廠台積電週四表示，已經用大約 5 億美元買進美國 AI 公司 Anthropic 的股票。由台積電的子公司 TSMC Partners 以每股 83 美元，取得 6,024,096 股。

US$83 was the price of Anthropic's initial public offering (IPO). Anthropic, which develops the Claude AI assistant, priced its IPO on Wednesday at a valuation of about US$1.5 trillion, and its shares were scheduled to begin trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday under the ticker ANT.
83 美元就是 Anthropic 首次公開發行（IPO）的價格。開發 AI 助理 Claude 的 Anthropic 週三訂出 IPO 價格，估值約 1.5 兆美元，股票預定週四在那斯達克掛牌交易，代號 ANT。

Even so, the purchase gives TSMC a stake of only about 0.03 percent. TSMC described the deal as primarily an equity investment. On November 10, its board had approved investments of up to US$500 million each in Anthropic shares and in preferred shares of OpenAI Group, the developer of ChatGPT.
即使花了這麼多錢，台積電也只持有大約 0.03% 的股份。台積電形容這筆交易主要是一項股權投資。台積電董事會在 11 月 10 日已經通過，可以分別投資最多 5 億美元在 Anthropic 的股票，以及 ChatGPT 開發商 OpenAI Group 的特別股。

and its shares were scheduled to begin trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday under the ticker ANT.
對等子句（and 連接第二件事）
analysis.note: price 在這裡當動詞「訂價」：price an IPO 訂出上市價格。be scheduled to + 原形動詞 表示「預定要…」，新聞很常用。under the ticker ANT 的 under 是「以…（名稱、代號）」。

analysis.zh: 全球最大的晶圓代工廠台積電週四表示，已經用大約 5 億美元買進美國 AI 公司 Anthropic 的股票。
parts: 同位語（說明台積電是什麼）
that it had bought shares in the American AI company Anthropic for about US$500 million.
that 名詞子句（said 的受詞）
analysis.note: 主詞後面用逗號夾住的同位語，直接說明它的身分。said 是過去式，所以 that 子句裡「買股票」這件更早發生的事用過去完成式 had bought。contract chipmaker（代工晶片廠）就是 foundry 的另一種說法。

quiz.q: How much did TSMC pay for each Anthropic share?
quiz.ex: 第一段：acquired 6,024,096 shares at US$83 each，每股 83 美元，也就是 IPO 價格。

quiz.q: Why does TSMC own only about 0.03 percent of Anthropic?
opts: Because Anthropic's total value is very large.
Because TSMC sold most of its shares.
quiz.ex: 第二、三段：Anthropic 估值約 1.5 兆美元，所以 5 億美元只占大約 0.03%。文中沒提到賣股或取消交易。

quiz.q: What did TSMC's board approve on November 10?
opts: Building a new factory in the U.S.
Investments of up to US$500 million each in Anthropic and OpenAI Group
quiz.ex: 第三段：its board had approved investments of up to US$500 million each in Anthropic shares and in preferred shares of OpenAI Group。

source.title: Focus Taiwan（CNA）：TSMC acquires 0.03% stake in Anthropic for US$500 million（2026/11/19）

items.title: Legislature Passes NT$20,000 Cash Handout Bill
items.titleZh: 立法院三讀通過每人發 2 萬元現金特別條例
items.teaser: 國民黨提的「全民發 2 萬元」特別條例，在民眾黨和民進黨都反對下，以 50 比 46 三讀通過。三黨各自怎麼說？錢夠不夠、要不要舉債，是爭論焦點。
paras: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passed a special bill on Friday to give every person NT$20,000 in cash. The bill, proposed by the opposition Kuomintang (KMT), passed its third and final reading by a vote of 50 to 46. The Taiwan People's Party (TPP) and the ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) voted against it.
立法院週五通過一項特別條例，要發給每個人 2 萬元現金。這項由在野的國民黨提出的條例，以 50 票對 46 票完成三讀。民眾黨和執政的民進黨都投下反對票。

KMT lawmaker Hsieh Lung-chieh said the government gave out NT$10,000 last year using tax surpluses, and this year's surpluses are expected to be larger thanks to AI-related business. He said the economic benefits should be shared with all the people. The TPP said it does not oppose sharing benefits, but there must first be a legal basis, and the government should not borrow money to pay for it.
國民黨立委謝龍介說，政府去年用超徵稅收發了 1 萬元，而今年因為 AI 相關產業，超徵預計會更多；他認為經濟成果應該和全民共享。民眾黨則說，並不反對分享經濟成果，但必須先有法源依據，而且政府不應該借錢來發。

DPP caucus official Chuang Jui-hsiung said the plan would cost NT$460 billion for 23 million people. Since this year's surplus is expected to be under NT$100 billion, he said the government would have to borrow more than NT$300 billion. Thirteen DPP lawmakers were absent, almost all of them candidates in the November 28 local elections.
民進黨團幹部莊瑞雄說，2,300 萬人每人 2 萬元，總共要花 4,600 億元。因為今年的超徵預計不到 1,000 億元，他說政府得舉債超過 3,000 億元。表決時有 13 位民進黨立委缺席，幾乎都是 11 月 28 日地方選舉的候選人。
words: 複數 surpluses｜a tax surplus 稅收超徵｜反義 deficit 赤字
opposes · opposed · opposing｜n. opposition 反對；在野黨｜adj. opposed 反對的（be opposed to…）
borrows · borrowed · borrowing｜n. borrowing 借款｜borrow money 借錢
n. absence 缺席｜反義 present 出席的｜be absent from… 沒出席…
複數 benefits｜v. benefit 使受益（benefits · benefited · benefiting）｜adj. beneficial 有益的

analysis.zh: 民眾黨則說，並不反對分享經濟成果，但必須先有法源依據，而且政府不應該借錢來發。
parts: it does not oppose sharing benefits,
受詞（省略 that 的名詞子句）
but there must first be a legal basis,
and the government should not borrow money to pay for it.
analysis.note: said 後面省略了 that，整串都是民眾黨說的內容。oppose 後面接動名詞：oppose + V-ing（反對做…）。there must be… 表示「一定要有…」。to pay for it 是不定詞表目的「用來支付」。

analysis.zh: 因為今年的超徵預計不到 1,000 億元，他說政府得舉債超過 3,000 億元。
parts: Since this year's surplus is expected to be under NT$100 billion,
since 引導的原因副詞子句
the government would have to borrow more than NT$300 billion.
受詞（省略 that 的名詞子句）
analysis.note: since 在句首常表示「因為、既然」，不一定是「自從」。be expected to + 原形動詞 表示「預計會…」。said 是過去式，所以子句裡用 would have to（將必須）做時態一致。

quiz.q: What was the result of the vote?
opts: All parties voted for the bill.
quiz.ex: 第一段：passed its third and final reading by a vote of 50 to 46，條例通過。

quiz.q: What is the TPP's main condition for cash handouts?
opts: Only the elderly should get money.
There must be a legal basis, and the government should not borrow.
The money must come from AI companies.
quiz.ex: 第二段：民眾黨不反對分享，但 there must first be a legal basis，而且 the government should not borrow money。

quiz.q: According to the DPP's Chuang, how much would the government need to borrow?
quiz.ex: 第三段：he said the government would have to borrow more than NT$300 billion。4,600 億元是總花費，1,000 億元是預估超徵。

source.title: Focus Taiwan（CNA）：TPP, DPP fail to derail KMT-backed NT$20,000 cash handout bill（2026/11/20）

items.title: Ancient Whale Had the Most Crooked Face Ever Found
items.titleZh: 600 萬年前的怪鯨魚 臉歪得破紀錄
items.teaser: 兩個鼻孔全擠到頭骨左邊、鼻吻往下彎 31 度！秘魯沙漠挖出的古代小抹香鯨，可能是史上臉最歪的哺乳動物，連名字都叫「浮誇」。
paras: Scientists have described an extinct pygmy sperm whale with an extremely crooked skull. The fossil was found in the 1990s in a desert in southern Peru, and the animal lived between 6.3 and 5.6 million years ago.
科學家描述了一種已經滅絕的小抹香鯨，牠的頭骨歪得非常厲害。這塊化石是 1990 年代在秘魯南部的沙漠裡發現的，這種動物生活在距今 630 萬到 560 萬年前。

Both of the whale's nostrils were shifted completely to the left side of its skull, and its snout pointed 31 degrees downward. The researchers say this is the most extreme facial asymmetry known in any whale or dolphin, and possibly in any mammal. They checked carefully and found that the skull had not been damaged or bent after the animal died.
這隻鯨魚的兩個鼻孔完全移到頭骨的左側，鼻吻部還往下彎 31 度。研究人員說，這是目前所有鯨豚中已知最極端的臉部不對稱，甚至可能是所有哺乳動物之最。他們仔細檢查後發現，頭骨並不是在動物死後才被壓壞或壓彎的。

Unlike modern sperm whales, which hunt squid in deep water, this species probably fed on the sea floor in shallow coastal waters. Its head could bend far downward, and it may have used sound to search soft sediment for prey. Scientists named it Scaphokogia huachafo, using a Peruvian Spanish word for something over-the-top.
現代抹香鯨會在深海獵捕魷魚，但這個物種很可能是在淺海沿岸的海底覓食。牠的頭可以大幅往下彎，可能利用聲音在柔軟的沉積物裡搜尋獵物。科學家把牠命名為 Scaphokogia huachafo，huachafo 是秘魯西班牙語，意思是「浮誇、過頭」。
words: n. extinction 滅絕｜become extinct 絕種｜an extinct species 已滅絕的物種
複數 skulls｜a fossil skull 頭骨化石
複數 asymmetries｜adj. asymmetric(al) 不對稱的｜反義 symmetry 對稱
單複數同形 species｜a new species 新物種｜endangered species 瀕危物種
不可數｜v. prey on… 捕食…（preys · preyed · preying）｜反義 predator 掠食者

analysis.zh: 現代抹香鯨會在深海獵捕魷魚，但這個物種很可能是在淺海沿岸的海底覓食。
parts: 修飾（介系詞片語：和…不同）
which hunt squid in deep water,
非限定關係子句（補充說明現代抹香鯨）
analysis.note: Unlike A, B… 是「和 A 不同，B…」的對比句型，寫作比較兩件事時很好用。注意 unlike 是介系詞，後面接名詞，不接子句。feed on… 是「以…為食」，這裡 fed on the sea floor 表示「在海底覓食」。

analysis.zh: 他們仔細檢查後發現，頭骨並不是在動物死後才被壓壞或壓彎的。
parts: that the skull had not been damaged or bent
受詞（that 名詞子句，過去完成被動式）
after 引導的時間副詞子句
analysis.note: had not been damaged or bent 是過去完成式被動語態（had been + p.p.），強調在「發現」之前就沒有被破壞過。bent 是 bend（彎曲）的過去分詞。

quiz.q: Where was the fossil found?
opts: In a desert in southern Peru
quiz.ex: 第一段：The fossil was found in the 1990s in a desert in southern Peru。

quiz.q: What was unusual about the whale's face?
opts: Both nostrils were on the left side of its skull.
Its eyes were on top of its head.
quiz.ex: 第二段：Both of the whale's nostrils were shifted completely to the left side of its skull。

quiz.q: How did this whale probably find food?
opts: It hunted squid in deep water.
It caught birds above the water.
It fed on the sea floor in shallow waters, maybe using sound.
It ate plants on the beach.
quiz.ex: 第三段：this species probably fed on the sea floor in shallow coastal waters，而且 may have used sound to search soft sediment for prey。在深海獵魷魚的是現代抹香鯨。

source.title: EurekAlert!（蘇黎世大學）：Prehistoric whale reveals extreme skull asymmetry（ScienceDaily 2026/11/19 轉載）

items.title: Anthony Davis Scores 36 as Wizards Beat Bulls in NBA Cup Game
items.titleZh: 戴維斯轟 36 分 巫師 98 比 94 擊敗公牛
items.teaser: NBA 盃賽事，戴維斯 36 分 11 籃板大爆發，Dybantsa 也繳出 20 分 10 籃板 6 助攻！公牛最後 43 秒追到只差 2 分，還是沒能翻盤。
paras: Anthony Davis scored 36 points and grabbed 11 rebounds as the Washington Wizards beat the Chicago Bulls 98-94 on Friday night in an NBA Cup game. AJ Dybantsa added 20 points, 10 rebounds and six assists for Washington.
NBA 盃賽事，華盛頓巫師週五晚上以 98 比 94 擊敗芝加哥公牛，戴維斯（Anthony Davis）攻下 36 分、抓下 11 個籃板。Dybantsa（AJ Dybantsa）也幫巫師貢獻 20 分、10 籃板和 6 次助攻。

Trae Young scored 16 points, and Kyshawn George had 11. For Chicago, Norman Powell led the team with 16 points, and Buddy Hield scored 15. Nic Claxton made two free throws to cut Washington's lead to 96-94 with 43 seconds left, but Washington held on to win.
楊恩（Trae Young）拿 16 分，喬治（Kyshawn George）拿 11 分。公牛方面，鮑威爾（Norman Powell）以 16 分領先全隊，希爾德（Buddy Hield）拿 15 分。比賽剩 43 秒時，克萊斯頓（Nic Claxton）罰進兩球，把巫師的領先縮小到 96 比 94，但巫師還是守住勝利。

Chicago played without Caleb Wilson, who missed his fifth straight game after having surgery on his right hand on Nov. 12. Washington improved to 6-11, while Chicago fell to 4-11. Both teams play again on Sunday, when the Wizards host Orlando and the Bulls host Denver.
公牛這場少了威爾森（Caleb Wilson），他 11 月 12 日右手動手術後，已經連續缺席 5 場。巫師戰績提升到 6 勝 11 敗，公牛則掉到 4 勝 11 敗。兩隊週日都會再出賽，巫師主場迎戰魔術，公牛主場對上金塊。
words: grabs · grabbed · grabbing｜grab a rebound 搶下籃板｜n. grab 抓取
複數 assists｜v. assist 協助（assists · assisted · assisting）｜n. assistant 助理
複數 leads｜v. lead 帶領；領先（leads · led · leading）｜cut the lead 縮小差距
複數 surgeries｜have surgery 動手術｜n. surgeon 外科醫生｜adj. surgical 手術的
hosts · hosted · hosting｜n. host 主人；主持人｜host a game 主場出賽

analysis.zh: 戴維斯攻下 36 分、抓下 11 個籃板，華盛頓巫師週五晚上在 NBA 盃比賽中以 98 比 94 擊敗芝加哥公牛。
parts: 動詞＋受詞（and 連接第二個動作）
as the Washington Wizards beat the Chicago Bulls 98-94
副詞子句（as 表示同時發生）
analysis.note: 主要子句是 Anthony Davis scored … and grabbed …，同一個主詞用 and 連接兩個過去式動詞。as 在這裡是「在…的同時／隨著」，帶出一整個子句說明比賽結果，是球賽新聞超常見的寫法：A scored X points as Team B won。比分 98-94 直接放在 beat 的受詞後面。

analysis.zh: 公牛這場少了威爾森，他 11 月 12 日右手動手術後，已經連續缺席第 5 場比賽。
parts: who missed his fifth straight game
非限定關係子句（補充說明 Wilson）
after having surgery on his right hand
修飾（after + 動名詞，表示時間）
analysis.note: 「, who …」是非限定關係子句，補充說明前面已經很明確的人名，所以要用逗號、不能用 that。after having surgery 是「介系詞 after + 動名詞」，主詞和主要子句相同（都是 Wilson）時可以這樣省略主詞。fifth straight game 是「連續第五場」，straight 當形容詞＝連續的。

quiz.q: How many points did Anthony Davis score?
quiz.ex: 第一段：Anthony Davis scored 36 points and grabbed 11 rebounds。11 是他的籃板數；20 分是 Dybantsa；16 分是 Young 和 Powell。

quiz.q: What happened with 43 seconds left in the game?
opts: Claxton's free throws made the score 96-94.
Caleb Wilson came back from injury.
quiz.ex: 第二段：Nic Claxton made two free throws to cut Washington's lead to 96-94 with 43 seconds left。公牛沒有反超，Wilson 也沒有上場。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Caleb Wilson had surgery on his left hand.
The Wizards will play Orlando at home on Sunday.
Buddy Hield was Chicago's top scorer.
quiz.ex: 第三段：the Wizards host Orlando（週日主場迎戰魔術）。公牛戰績是 4 勝 11 敗；Wilson 是右手手術；公牛得分最高的是 16 分的 Powell，Hield 是 15 分。

items.title: TSMC and Samsung Reportedly Pause Some Chip Shipments to China
items.titleZh: 美國新規上路 傳台積電、三星暫停部分對中國晶片出貨
items.teaser: 美國取消非 AI 晶片的豁免，連手機晶片都要申請許可！傳台積電要求受影響的中國客戶停下 16 奈米以下先進製程訂單，只能用 28、40 奈米等較舊製程。
paras: Taiwan's TSMC and South Korea's Samsung have reportedly told some Chinese customers that certain chip shipments will stop for now. According to reports, new U.S. rules remove exemptions for chips designed for non-AI uses, such as smartphones. The two chipmakers must now seek U.S. licenses for consumer chips made with advanced processes.
據報導，台灣的台積電和南韓的三星已經通知部分中國客戶，某些晶片出貨會暫時停止。報導指出，美國新規定取消了非 AI 用途晶片（例如智慧型手機晶片）的豁免，兩家晶片廠現在用先進製程生產消費性晶片，都必須向美國申請許可。

Reuters reported that TSMC told affected Chinese customers to halt orders that use 16-nanometer or more advanced processes unless they get U.S. export licenses. These chip designers will generally be limited to older 28nm and 40nm processes. TSMC has also reportedly stepped up checks on customers' parent companies, major shareholders and shipping routes.
路透社報導，台積電要求受影響的中國客戶，除非取得美國出口許可，否則要停下使用 16 奈米及更先進製程的訂單。這些晶片設計公司大致只能使用較舊的 28 奈米和 40 奈米製程。據報導，台積電也加強審查客戶的母公司、主要股東和運輸路線。

According to the Financial Times, TSMC makes smartphone processors for Chinese brands such as Xiaomi, Oppo and Vivo. Industry sources said smartphone chips are still likely to receive licenses, but long approval times could disrupt production.
根據《金融時報》，台積電替小米、OPPO、vivo 等中國品牌生產手機處理器。業界人士表示，手機晶片應該還是有機會拿到許可，但審核時間太長可能會打亂生產。
words: 複數 shipments｜v. ship 運送（ships · shipped · shipping）｜chip shipments 晶片出貨
複數 exemptions｜v. exempt 使豁免（exempts · exempted · exempting）｜adj. exempt 被豁免的
複數 licenses｜export license 出口許可｜v. license 發許可（licenses · licensed · licensing）
halts · halted · halting｜n. halt 停止｜come to a halt 停下來
disrupts · disrupted · disrupting｜n. disruption 中斷；混亂｜adj. disruptive 破壞性的

analysis.zh: 路透社報導，台積電要求受影響的中國客戶，除非取得美國出口許可，否則要停下使用 16 奈米及更先進製程的訂單。
parts: that TSMC told affected Chinese customers to halt orders
受詞（that 名詞子句：報導的內容）
that use 16-nanometer or more advanced processes
限定關係子句（修飾 orders）
unless they get U.S. export licenses.
analysis.note: 整句有三層子句：report that …（報導說…）→ that 子句裡有 tell + 人 + to V（要求某人做某事）→ orders 後面接限定關係子句 that use …，說明是「哪些訂單」。unless 等於 if … not，unless they get licenses＝如果他們沒拿到許可。affected 是過去分詞當形容詞：受影響的客戶。

analysis.zh: 業界人士表示，手機晶片應該還是有機會拿到許可，但審核時間太長可能會打亂生產。
parts: smartphone chips are still likely to receive licenses,
受詞（省略 that 的名詞子句）
but long approval times could disrupt production.
對等子句（but 表示轉折）
analysis.note: said 後面省略了 that，直接接名詞子句。be likely to + V 是「很可能會…」，比 will 委婉，新聞常用來表達推測。could + V 表示「可能會」，帶有不確定的語氣。approval times 是「核准所需的時間」，名詞 approval 當形容詞修飾 times。

quiz.q: What do the new U.S. rules reportedly change?
opts: They ban all chip sales to Asia.
They remove exemptions for chips made for non-AI uses.
They lower taxes on smartphone chips.
They allow Chinese companies to build factories in the U.S.
quiz.ex: 第一段：new U.S. rules remove exemptions for chips designed for non-AI uses, such as smartphones。其他選項文章都沒有提到。

quiz.q: Without a license, which processes can affected Chinese designers generally still use at TSMC?
quiz.ex: 第二段：These chip designers will generally be limited to older 28nm and 40nm processes。16 奈米以下的先進製程要停下。

quiz.q: Why might smartphone production be affected even if licenses are given?
opts: Because approval could take a long time.
Because TSMC will close its factories.
Because the chips are too expensive.
quiz.ex: 第三段：smartphone chips are still likely to receive licenses, but long approval times could disrupt production。問題在於審核時間很長。

items.title: Parties Step Up Campaigning a Week Before Local Elections
items.titleZh: 九合一選舉倒數一週 各黨全力衝刺
items.teaser: 11 月 28 日投票倒數一週！賴總統、蔡英文、蕭美琴、鄭麗文、黃國昌、柯文哲週六全員出動，雙北候選人跑市場、辦造勢晚會。
paras: With Taiwan's local elections set for Nov. 28, political parties stepped up their campaigning on Saturday. Voters will choose mayors and county magistrates in 22 cities and counties, as well as other local officials.
台灣地方選舉訂在 11 月 28 日投票，各政黨週六加緊拉票。選民將選出 22 個縣市的市長和縣長，以及其他地方公職人員。

In Taipei, Kuomintang (KMT) Mayor Chiang Wan-an, the incumbent, visited a market in Neihu District. His Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) challenger, Puma Shen, held an evening rally with Su Chiao-hui, the DPP's New Taipei mayoral candidate. Former President Tsai Ing-wen and Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim attended another rally for Su, while the KMT's New Taipei candidate, Lee Shu-chuan, campaigned in Zhonghe District.
在台北，尋求連任的國民黨籍市長蔣萬安到內湖區的市場拜票。他的民進黨對手沈伯洋則和民進黨新北市長候選人蘇巧慧舉辦晚間造勢活動。前總統蔡英文和副總統蕭美琴也出席了蘇巧慧的另一場造勢；國民黨新北市長候選人李四川則到中和區拜票。

President Lai Ching-te, who chairs the DPP, campaigned for DPP candidates in Miaoli and Yunlin counties. KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun joined a motorcade in Changhua County, and Taiwan People's Party (TPP) Chairman Huang Kuo-chang and party founder Ko Wen-je campaigned for TPP city council candidates in Taipei. The KMT and the TPP, the two largest opposition parties, have agreed not to run competing candidates in some local races.
兼任民進黨主席的賴清德總統，到苗栗縣和雲林縣替民進黨候選人輔選。國民黨主席鄭麗文在彰化縣參加車隊掃街；民眾黨主席黃國昌和創黨人柯文哲則在台北替民眾黨市議員候選人拉票。國民黨和民眾黨這兩個最大的在野黨，已經同意在部分地方選舉中不推出互相競爭的候選人。

items.title: Scientists Turn Moon Dust Into LEGO-Like Bricks
items.titleZh: 用雷射把「月球土」變成樂高積木 未來月球基地的建材？
items.teaser: 不加任何黏著劑，只靠雷射一層一層加熱，模擬月球土就自己黏成十字形、H 形的小積木，還能互相卡在一起！
paras: Engineers at the University of Arkansas have used a laser to turn fake moon dust into small building blocks that fit together like LEGO bricks. The work could one day help future lunar bases use local materials instead of bricks brought from Earth.
美國阿肯色大學的工程師用雷射，把模擬的月球塵土變成能像樂高積木一樣互相卡在一起的小建材。這項研究未來也許能讓月球基地使用當地的材料，而不用從地球運磚頭上去。

The team used a material called LHS-1, which is made to resemble rock samples brought back by the Apollo missions. They heated the powder layer by layer with a relatively low-power laser. No binder was added, so the dust stuck only to itself. The blocks, a few centimeters across, came in shapes such as crosses and H shapes.
研究團隊使用一種叫 LHS-1 的材料，它是仿照阿波羅任務帶回來的岩石樣本製作的。他們用功率相對較低的雷射，一層一層加熱粉末。過程中完全沒有加黏著劑，塵土只靠自己黏在一起。做出來的積木只有幾公分大，有十字形、H 形等形狀。

However, the blocks have more tiny holes and are weaker than those made with binders. First author Cole McCallum said the process is not yet ready for parts that carry heavy loads. Scientists also need to test how the blocks behave in the Moon's low gravity and vacuum.
不過，這些積木內部的小孔比較多，強度也比加了黏著劑的成品差。第一作者麥卡勒姆（Cole McCallum）說，這個方法目前還不能用來做承重的部件。科學家也還要測試，這些積木在月球的低重力和真空環境下會有什麼表現。
words: resembles · resembled · resembling｜n. resemblance 相似之處｜（不用進行式、不接 to）
複數 layers｜layer by layer 一層一層地｜v. layer 分層堆疊（layers · layered · layering）
複數 binders｜v. bind 綁；黏合（binds · bound · binding）
複數 loads｜carry heavy loads 承受重物｜v. load 裝載（loads · loaded · loading）
複數 vacuums｜in a vacuum 在真空中｜v. vacuum 用吸塵器吸（vacuums · vacuumed · vacuuming）

analysis.zh: 研究團隊使用一種叫 LHS-1 的材料，它是仿照阿波羅任務帶回來的岩石樣本製作的。
parts: 受詞（called LHS-1 是過去分詞片語，修飾 material）
which is made to resemble rock samples
非限定關係子句（補充說明 LHS-1）
brought back by the Apollo missions.
修飾（過去分詞片語，修飾 samples）
analysis.note: 這句有兩個「過去分詞片語當形容詞」：a material called LHS-1＝一種叫 LHS-1 的材料；rock samples brought back by …＝被帶回來的岩石樣本，都是省略了 which is / that were。be made to + V 是「被做成可以…」。resemble 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，不要寫成 resemble to。

analysis.zh: 第一作者麥卡勒姆說，這個方法目前還不能用來做承重的部件。
parts: 主詞（First author 當頭銜放在人名前）
the process is not yet ready for parts
受詞（省略 that 的名詞子句）
限定關係子句（修飾 parts）
analysis.note: said 後面省略了 that。not yet 是「還沒」，放在 be 動詞後面：is not yet ready。parts that carry heavy loads 用限定關係子句，說明是「哪一種部件」——要承重的那種，所以不加逗號。

quiz.q: What did the engineers use to turn the moon dust into blocks?
quiz.ex: 第一段：have used a laser to turn fake moon dust into small building blocks。第二段也說沒有加黏著劑（No binder was added）。

quiz.q: What is LHS-1?
opts: A material made to be like Apollo rock samples
quiz.ex: 第二段：LHS-1, which is made to resemble rock samples brought back by the Apollo missions。它是模擬月球土，不是真的月球土。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The blocks are stronger than ones made with binders.
The blocks are already used on the Moon.
The blocks still need to be tested in low gravity and vacuum.
The blocks are about one meter across.
quiz.ex: 第三段：Scientists also need to test how the blocks behave in the Moon's low gravity and vacuum。積木比較弱、只有幾公分大，也還沒用在月球上。
